2607.02431.title: WorldSample: Closed-loop Real-robot RL with World Modelling
2607.02431.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can overcome the demonstration-coverage limitation of imitation learning (IL) by allowing robots to improve through trial-and-error interaction beyond the states observed in demonstrations. However, deploying RL on real robots remains constrained by high interaction costs, since each physical rollout is costly and reflects only one realized action-outcome path. To address this challenge, we propose WorldSample, a physically grounded data augmentation framework for real-robot RL that closes a real-synthetic loop between physical rollouts, world-model generation, and policy improvement. Grounded on real rollouts, WorldSample generates high-fidelity synthetic transitions through a post-trained world model, which greatly lowers the visual hallucination. Specifically, rather than simply using these transitions as real-world experience, WorldSample introduces Policy-Paced Learning (PPL) to regulate the training process through sample selection and scheduling, balancing useful augmentation against value overestimation and mitigating the hallucination-induced noise. Experiments on robot manipulation tasks involving contact-rich and precise tasks show that WorldSample improves policy success rate by 28% while reducing training steps by 59% compared with baselines. Furthermore, WorldSample improves world model visual fidelity by 19.4dB in PSNR and 0.47 in SSIM over demonstration-only post-training, validating the effectiveness of the real-synthetic loop for both policy and world model performance.
2607.02431.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習 (RL) 可以克服模仿學習 (IL) 的示範覆蓋限制，因為它允許機器人通過試錯互動來改進，超越在示範中觀察到的狀態。<lb/>然而，在真實機器人上部署 RL 仍然受到高互動成本的限制，因為每次實體執行的成本很高，並且僅反映一條實現的行動-結果路徑。<lb/>為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了 WorldSample，一個基於物理的數據增強框架，用於真實機器人的 RL，該框架在物理執行、世界模型生成和策略改進之間關閉了一個真實-合成的循環。<lb/>基於真實執行，WorldSample 通過後訓練的世界模型生成高保真度的合成過渡，這大大降低了視覺幻覺。<lb/>具體而言，WorldSample 並不僅僅將這些過渡用作真實世界的經驗，而是引入了政策驅動學習 (PPL)，通過樣本選擇和排程來調節訓練過程，平衡有用的增強與價值高估之間的關係，並減輕由幻覺引起的噪音。<lb/>在涉及接觸豐富和精確任務的機器人操作任務中的實驗顯示，與基準相比，WorldSample 將策略成功率提高了 28%，同時將訓練步驟減少了 59%。<lb/>此外，WorldSample 在 PSNR 中將世界模型的視覺保真度提高了 19.4dB，在 SSIM 中提高了 0.47，相較於僅進行示範後訓練，驗證了真實-合成循環對於策略和世界模型性能的有效性。
